title: Change in the size of apical radiolucencies in adolescent's mature maxillary incisors following retreatment with two regenerative endodontic techniques: a 12 -month randomised clinical trial using volume -based cone -beam computed tomography
authors: Wahba NKO, Bahnasy SSEL, ElMakawi YM, Dummer PMH, Nagendrababu V, Rossi-Fedele G, Sans FA, Pasqualini D, Alovisi M, Turky M, Ahmed EF, Elheeny AAH. Clin Oral Investig. 2025 May 3;29(5):283. doi: 10.1007/s00784-025-06344-y. * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “REPs using BC or PRF techniques when retreating root canal -treated mature permanent central incisors in adolescents with apical radiolucencies had comparable clinical and radiographic outcomes one year following treatment associated with significantly more positive responses to thermal and electric pulp tests in the PRF group” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
